授業概要
This course explores the role of information and communications technology (ICT) in fostering development initiatives worldwide. It examines how ICT can be leveraged to address socio-economic challenges and promote sustainable development in various contexts. Through theoretical discussions, case studies, and practical exercises, students will gain insights into the potential of ICT for enhancing livelihoods and addressing critical social issues including governance, healthcare, education, and more, particularly within developing regions.

全体の教育目標
Upon completion of this course, students will attain a robust understanding of the foundational concepts and principles that underpin Information Communications Technology for Development (ICTD). They will adeptly apply ICT solutions to effectively tackle a diverse array of development challenges, leveraging both theoretical knowledge and practical skills. Through the analysis of case studies, students will gain the ability to critically evaluate the impact and efficacy of various ICTD initiatives in real-world contexts. Furthermore, students will hone their critical thinking abilities, enabling them to identify problems within the ICTD sphere and propose innovative solutions. Finally, students will design a social business model that can sustainably solve the identified problem by using the power of technology.
